Make a floating finger
Make a floating finger
Touch your fingertips,
about a hand's length
from your eyes.
Now look past them,
at something far away.
See it?
A little floating
finger,
with two tips.
Pull them apart a bit. It floats.
Your eyes aim far,
so each eye sees your
fingers in a different place.
Your brain lays both
views on top of each other.
Where the two fingertips
overlap,
you see a floating finger.
Look back at your
fingers,
and it is gone.
